```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```


```{r}
con = DBI::dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), "../data/midwest_airbnb_extended.db")
listings     = DBI::dbReadTable(con, "listings") |> tibble::as_tibble()
availability = DBI::dbReadTable(con, "availability_monthly") |> tibble::as_tibble()
reviews      = DBI::dbReadTable(con, "reviews_monthly") |> tibble::as_tibble()
DBI::dbDisconnect(con)
```


```{r}
 listings |> dplyr::group_by(city, host_id) |> dplyr::summarise(host_id_count = dplyr::n()) |> dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(host_id_count))
```

## Task 1
```{r}
host_counts <- listings |>
  dplyr::count(host_id, name = "host_listings")
```

```{r}
listings2 <- listings |> 
  dplyr::left_join(host_counts, by = "host_id")
```

```{r}
host_counts |> 
  dplyr::filter(host_listings>= 10) |>
  dplyr::summarise(A1= dplyr::n())

host_counts
```

```{r}
listings2 |>
  dplyr::filter(city=="Chicago") |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    A2 = mean(host_listings >= 10) *100
  
  )
```

## Task 2
```{r}
listings |> 
  dplyr::filter(
    room_type == "Entire home/apt",
    accommodates>=4,
    number_of_reviews >= 10,
    review_scores_rating>= 4.8
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    price_per_person= price / accommodates
  ) |> 
  dplyr:: group_by(city, neighbourhood) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    median_price_per_person = 
  median(price_per_person, na.rm = TRUE),
    n=dplyr::n()
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(
    n >=20,
    city== "Columbus"
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(median_price_per_person)

```

## Task 3
```{r}
listings |>
  dplyr::group_by(city, room_type) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    dplyr::across(
      c(price, reviews_per_month, 
estimated_revenue_l365d),
    ~median(.x, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
)
  
```

## Task 4
```{r}
listings |>
  dplyr::group_by(city) |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(
estimated_revenue_l365d), .by_group = TRUE) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    top_10 = dplyr::row_number() <= ceiling(0.10*
dplyr::n())
  ) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    total_revenue=
sum(estimated_revenue_l365d,na.rm=TRUE), 
  top_10_revenue=
sum(estimated_revenue_l365d[top_10],na.rm=TRUE),
  top_10_percent=top_10_revenue /
total_revenue*100
) |>
dplyr::filter(city=="Columbus")
  
```

## Task 5
```{r}
listings |>
  dplyr::filter(room_type=="Entire home/apt") |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    availability |>
      dplyr::filter(month=="2026-10"),
    by="id"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    mostly_taken= nights_available < 0.5 *nights_in_month
  ) |>
  dplyr::group_by(city) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    share_mostly_taken= mean(mostly_taken) * 100
  ) |> 
  dplyr::arrange(share_mostly_taken)
```

## Task 6
```{r}
reviews |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    listings |>
      dplyr::select(id,city),
    by = "id"
  )|>
  dplyr::filter(
    month>= "2025-07",
    month<="2026-06"
  )|>
  dplyr::group_by(city,month) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    total_reviews=sum(reviews,na.rm=TRUE)
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(city=="Twin Cities") |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(total_reviews))
  
```

## Task 7
```{r}
superhost_summary<-listings |>
  dplyr::filter(
    room_type=="Entire home/apt",
    host_is_superhost %in% c("t","f")
  )|>
  dplyr::group_by(city,host_is_superhost) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    median_price=median(price,na.rm=TRUE),
    median_rating=median(review_scores_rating,
na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```
